comparison.objective: Insert a USB-C cable into a handheld spot welder and set the device down.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual device stabilization, submillimetre plug alignment, compliant cable handling, and straight insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Plug centre within 0.5 mm, body within 1.5 mm of the device face, tilt at most 8 degrees, device released safely. No separate spec is present.
comparison.reason: Tests close-clearance connector insertion rather than adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
